notes: Desktop IPTV set-top box (not rack-mountable, rackUnits omitted). Primary source is Amino's own product datasheet (PDF hosted in distributor Intelek.cz's document repository, authored/branded by Amino Communications, contact aminocom.com) which gives functional I/O and detailed spec table but not a rear-panel connector diagram. Physical connector types/layout were cross-checked against the Amino AmiNET130 Installation Manual (ManualsLib, 'Back Panel Connections' page) which enumerates: Power (5V DC), USB, Ethernet ('Digital TV input'), HDMI, A/V OUT (Component/SCART/S-Video/Composite/stereo audio breakout), SPDIF (optical), and RF antenna in/out (loop-through). HDMI version/grade is not stated by Amino and was left unset; the single A/V OUT breakout connector has no exact match in the allowed connector list and was approximated as 'rca' with a note. Confidence set to medium because of these two inferences/approximations; all other ports (power, USB, Ethernet, SPDIF, RF, HDMI presence) are confirmed by the manufacturer datasheet and/or installation manual.

ports.name: Power (5V DC)
ports.note: External plug-top power supply, 5V 1500mA per datasheet

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Labeled 'USB' on rear panel; datasheet calls it 'USB 2.0 Peripheral Port' for connecting accessories (e.g. IR keyboard)

ports.name: Ethernet (Digital TV input)
ports.note: 10/100Base-T IP network interface carrying the IPTV service; rear panel diagram labels it 'Digital TV input'

ports.name: HDMI
ports.note: Digital HD output with HDCP; exact HDMI version not stated in the manufacturer datasheet (one third-party Amino A-series config guide references HDMI 1.2a but that is not confirmed specifically for this model)

ports.name: A/V Out
ports.note: Single proprietary multi-pin breakout jack (not a bare RCA) that fans out via optional dongle cables to Composite, S-Video, Component (YPbPr), SCART/RGB, and stereo analogue audio; 'rca' chosen as closest listed connector type

ports.name: SPDIF
ports.note: Optical digital audio out, stereo and Dolby 5.1 surround pass-through

ports.name: RF Antenna Out
ports.note: Loop-through RF output to a second TV
